Hello!
I would like an image of T社2級徴収職職員 ロージャ.
In this scenario, she is seducing the viewer in a T Corp love hotel. Her suit is partially unbuttoned, and she first shows off her chest by pulling on her bra in a way like https://x.com/Nivaris_art/status/1990508900425048207/
She then takes off her bra and shows it off to the viewer, holding it in one hand like https://x.com/amidosansyoku/status/1924377581304115227
Please make her bra a fancy red lace bra, to stand out from the sepia.
